summary: Himalaya Shipping Ltd. (HSHP) filed a Form 6-K reporting a mandatory notification of trade by its board chairman, Bjorn Isaksen. Mr. Isaksen settled a prior forward purchase agreement for 200,000 shares and entered a new forward purchase agreement to buy 200,000 shares from Drew Holdings Ltd. at USD 15.22 per share, settling June 17, 2029, with a 6% annual interest adjustment less dividends. The filing discloses a PDMR transaction under MAR, not a corporate event. It does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics are mentioned. This is a routine insider trade notification, not a transaction affecting the company's structure or strategy.
